description: Image Description: The image features a large, elaborate floral arrangement displayed in a cream-colored ceramic vase with a wide, rounded shape and a dark base. The bouquet is composed of a diverse array of flowers and foliage, creating a vibrant and dynamic composition. Prominent among the flowers are white lilies with their elegant, trumpet-shaped blooms and slightly recurved petals, some of which have subtle pink or yellow tinges at the base. Interspersed among the lilies are clusters of purple allium
